import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
point = ee.Geometry.Point([157.706220, -34.344553])  # Note: longitude, latitude
region = point.buffer(100000)  # 100km radius in meters

# Time periods for comparison
period1_start = '2019-11-01'
period1_end = '2020-03-01'  # Exclusive of March 1
period2_start = '2018-11-01'
period2_end = '2019-03-01'

# 2. Data Acquisition - MERRA-2 for black carbon AOD
collection1 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GSFC/MERRA/aer/2') \
    .filterDate(period1_start, period1_end) \
    .filterBounds(region) \
    .select('BCEXTTAU')  # Black carbon extinction AOD

collection2 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GSFC/MERRA/aer/2') \
    .filterDate(period2_start, period2_end) \
    .filterBounds(region) \
    .select('BCEXTTAU')

# Check collection sizes
size1 = collection1.size().getInfo()
size2 = collection2.size().getInfo()

print(f"2019-2020 Images: {size1}")
print(f"2018-2019 Images: {size2}")

# Handle empty collections
if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0:
    print(f"No data for {'2019-2020' if size1 == 0 else '2018-2019'} period.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Compute mean AOD for each period
    mean_img1 = collection1.mean()
    mean_img2 = collection2.mean()
    
    # Get pixel counts to check for valid data
    count1 = mean_img1.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=region,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('BCEXTTAU').getInfo()
    
    count2 = mean_img2.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=region,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('BCEXTTAU').getInfo()
    
    print(f"2019-2020 Valid Pixels: {count1}")
    print(f"2018-2019 Valid Pixels: {count2}")
    
    if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels in one or both periods.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # 4. Calculation - Get mean black carbon AOD values
        val1 = mean_img1.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=region,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('BCEXTTAU').getInfo()
        
        val2 = mean_img2.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=region,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('BCEXTTAU').getInfo()
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        print(f"2019-2020 Mean BC AOD: {val1:.4f}")
        print(f"2018-2019 Mean BC AOD: {val2:.4f}")
        print(f"Difference: {val1 - val2:.4f}")
        
        # Check for calculation failures
        if val1 is None or val2 is None or \
           not isinstance(val1, (int, float)) or \
           not isinstance(val2, (int, float)) or \
           abs(val1) > 10 or abs(val2) > 10:  # Unreasonable AOD values
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif val1 > val2:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
